verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's first-party docs describe scheduling recurring tasks that run in the background, with a Scheduled view to review active, paused and completed tasks and recent runs. Event triggers from Gmail, Slack or GitHub can also start tasks without polling. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that background automations run reliably, detailed documentation of setup and configuration options or limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Schedule recurring tasks to run in the background.
Review active, paused, and completed tasks and recent runs in Scheduled.
scheduled tasks can run when a supported Gmail, Slack, or GitHub event occurs
Use an event trigger to triage new email, summarize channel activity, or act on pull request feedback without polling on a fixed cadence.
